facts.text: Serve the mains when Black Phillip shows up in the yard.
facts.why: Black Phillip is the family's goat from the start of the film, so he never shows up. The printed card line is the same text. A real turning point is when he speaks to Thomasin near the end.
facts.fix: Serve the mains when Black Phillip speaks to Thomasin.

facts.text: The corn failed again, so supper is thin tonight. Father says grace twice, and Mother still counts for the silver cup.
facts.why: Thomasin never says this and it is set in quote marks. It is an invented line. Katherine does blame Thomasin for the missing silver cup, which William later admits he traded.
facts.fix: Set it as an unquoted family note: Corn failed again. Father says grace twice. Mother still wants her silver cup.

fix_note.text: The corn failed again, so supper is thin tonight. Father says grace twice, and Mother still asks after her silver cup.
